# PyroGuard

> All-in-one operations platform for fire & life-safety inspection contractors: recurring
> inspection scheduling, offline field inspections (NFPA 25/72/10/80), AHJ report filing,
> deficiency-to-quote pipeline, and invoicing in one system. Currently being rebuilt from the
> ground up (v2); the previous demo has been retired.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pyroguard-demo.netlify.app/): What PyroGuard is and the five workflows it closes — schedule, inspect, file, quote, invoice.
- [A Day in the Field](https://pyroguard-demo.netlify.app/demo): Playable ~4-minute demo — walk one real NFPA 25 sprinkler inspection as the inspector, including offline photo capture in a no-signal parking garage, NFPA 25 severity classification, AHJ filing via The Compliance Engine, and a same-day invoice.
